description: Selected registration input after the finite P39 13-class GM-enabled membership update. The class memberships are emitted by the committed post-thinning continuation; atlas-space shape priors are carried separately from the committed P39aq registration fixture because membership consumes transformed maps while registerShapes samples atlas-space priors.
scope_limitations: This fixture validates selected registerShapes on a synthetic post-membership map and explicit atlas-space priors.
The Java harness is a source-formula excerpt using copied ParametricTransform, RotationMatrix, ImageFunctions, and Numerics helpers, not execution of the complete LesionTOADS classes.
The synthetic registration trace contains five rejected NaN trial energies; the accepted trial and final handoff are finite. This pins the selected comparison/rejection behavior only.
This does not validate the complete iterative LesionTOADS workflow, real atlas alignment, or real imaging data.
